caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, symmetrical object that is primarily yellowish-gold in color. The object is vertically oriented with a pointed top and a wide base that curves outward. The design includes a central vertical panel decorated with a symmetrical pattern of swirling lines, flanked on both sides by decorative, scroll-like cutouts. The upper section of the object features several rounded cutout shapes in a stacked arrangement, topped by a single pointed tip. The outer edges of the object are smooth and curved, giving the piece a balanced appearance. The background is plain and beige, and there is a handwritten label beneath the object that reads "Albert Lenoir."
title: Patch Box from Ky. Rifle
